name: Setup Go environment
description: Setup a Go environment and add it to the PATH

go-version.description: The Go version to download (if necessary) and use. Supports semver spec and ranges.

check-latest.description: Set this option to true if you want the action to always check for the latest available version that satisfies the version spec

stable.description: Whether to download only stable versions

token.description: Used to pull node distributions from go-versions.  Since there's a default, this is typically not supplied by the user.
